# Art Fold

> https://www.artfold.xyz

Art Fold is a minimal web app to discover public-domain and open-access museum art, browse works from partner museum APIs, and curate a personal six-work digital exhibition with a shareable public URL.

## Key URLs

- https://www.artfold.xyz/
- https://www.artfold.xyz/about
- https://www.artfold.xyz/how-it-works
- https://www.artfold.xyz/museum-sources
- https://www.artfold.xyz/faq
- https://www.artfold.xyz/sitemap.xml

Site credits and author link appear in the app footer on the home page.
